allowed_changes: use exact frozen 71-event Federal Reserve policy-change file
same-day policy event is unavailable; event must be strictly earlier than execution date
easing state holds 100% QQQ adjusted-close total-return proxy
trade only when easing/tightening state changes
comparison_gates: Sharpe > QQQ buy-and-hold on identical total-return/FX window
expected_outputs: Fed-policy candidate, QQQ buy-hold and cash portfolio CSVs
actual trade count, max gross, minimum cash and target fingerprint
follow_up_policy: After any formal performance is viewed, do not alter policy-state definition, direction mapping, QQQ asset, event dates, cost, or add a filter in this lineage. A policy-level or surprise-based strategy is a different economic hypothesis and must be separately preregistered.
forbidden_changes: using policy-rate level, magnitude, moving average or months-since-change thresholds
using FOMC surprise, futures-implied changes or forward guidance
changing QQQ to SPY/MTUM/other asset after results
adding VIX, trend, yield-curve, Sahm, credit or volatility confirmation
shorting, borrowing, financing, leverage or gross exposure above 100%
hypothesis: Equity discount rates and liquidity conditions respond asymmetrically to the direction of Federal Reserve policy. A deliberately slow rule that owns a growth-equity total-return proxy only after the most recent official federal-funds target change was a cut, and otherwise holds CNY cash after the most recent target change was a hike, may capture the long monetary easing/tightening cycle with only a handful of trades and without forecasting the magnitude or timing of future policy moves.
pass_fail_gates: at least 70% of seven fixed folds have Sharpe >0
max realized gross <=100% and minimum cash >=0
research_basis: Federal Reserve official Open Market Operations archive and FOMC target-rate tables provide historical target changes
Federal Reserve policy-rate pages confirm target-range effective dates and current 2026 level; strategy uses only direction, not rate level or change magnitude
Monetary-policy/equity literature motivates expansive versus restrictive regimes; this trial uses a fixed last-change-direction definition rather than tuning a lookback or threshold
selection_metric: No threshold, lookback, persistence or asset search. Exactly one state variable: direction of the most recent official Fed target change strictly before execution date. Down=easing=QQQ, up=tightening=cash. Validation, objective and QQQ comparison are separate ATM-SVP-3 axes.

shared_rules.policy_state: direction of latest official target change strictly before execution date

strategy_lineage: fed-policy-direction-001 / Fed政策方向001; low-turnover easing-versus-tightening QQQ allocation
swift_engine_entrypoint: scripts/run_fed_policy_direction_001.py -> official-policy-change CSV + immutable tools/fed_policy_direction_001_logic.swift -> frozen QQQ/SPY total-return proxies + historical USD/CNY -> BacktestEngine.runResearchTargetProviderStrategyWithTrace
validation_gates: base run already includes product-level transaction cost
